verdict.rationale: OneDrive is a file storage/sync service, not an automation/workflow platform; it has no concept of building, versioning, or rolling back 'automations' (e.g., flows, scripts, agent tasks). The evidence only covers file version history and delta/change-notification APIs for files, which is a different axis (file versioning) rather than automation lifecycle management, so this story is a category error for this product type.
